summary.text: Carrie Hamblen is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 38 in Doña Ana County.
Hamblen chairs the Senate Tax, Business and Transportation Committee and also sits on the Senate Conservation Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Hamblen's occupation as "CEO- LC Green COC" and a district office in Las Cruces.
Between sessions, Hamblen is vice chair of the Revenue Stabilization and Tax Policy Committee and a member of the Interim Legislative Ethics Committee.
